customManagers.description: Update dependencies in Ansible YAML files based on renovate comments

packageRules.description: GHCR exposes no release timestamps, so minimumReleaseAge would block these forever. Skip the gate, and flag the PR for a manual release-date check.
prBodyNotes: **No release-age delay:** GHCR publishes no release timestamps, so the 7-day `minimumReleaseAge` was not applied to this update. Check the release date upstream before merging.

packageRules.description: Postgres/Valkey follow the Immich release compose, not their own registries; scripts/ci/check_immich_compose.py enforces it
Immich PRs: the DB/cache pins may have to move with the release
prBodyNotes: **Before merging:** read the release notes. If CI fails on *Immich's Postgres and Valkey pins*, copy the two values it prints into `roles/immich/defaults/main.yml`.
